positioning.eyebrow: Structural Openings → Evidence → Decision Memory → Outcomes
positioning.headline: The world changes before consensus does. We record the gap.
positioning.lead: StructureEvidence identifies structural openings in industrial and technical systems, then verifies what the evidence actually establishes before a decision is made.
positioning.structural_opening: A structural opening appears when a constraint, dependency, cost curve, regulation, or incumbent advantage begins to weaken before the market has fully repriced the change.
positioning.decision_memory: Preserve what was known, unknown, contradicted, verified, and frozen at the time of the decision.
